name: San Bernardino County, California (United States)
description: Navy blue upper half with five yellow stars over a silhouette of white mountains, and a white lower half bearing a yellow arrowhead logo dated 1853 above the words SAN BERNARDINO COUNTY on a navy band.
history: San Bernardino County is the largest county in the contiguous United States by area. Flags of the World records that the Board of Supervisors adopted this flag on 3 December 2024, the third in the county's history and the first since 1984; the five stars stand for the supervisorial districts and 1853 is the year the county was established.
